name: CORPUS MINE — all our existence, loaded and digested

lanes.prompt: You are a gopher. Explore memory/research_packs/ (159 packs). Inventory what domains exist, name the 5 most load-bearing packs with one line each, list 5 packs that are stale or superseded, and 3 reusable mechanisms. Cite paths. Return structured findings, no preamble.

You are a gopher. Explore watch/inbox/ (900+ cards, sampled) + watch/inbox/INDEX.json. What are the distinct card families, which 5 cards are load-bearing doctrine, which 5 are stale one-day affairs, and what does the register say the fleet cares about most? Cite paths. Structured findings, no preamble.

You are a gopher. Read memory/rib/ (43 RIB doctrine files). Extract the 10 load-bearing invariants with one line each, note which RIBs overlap or contradict, and name the 3 a new seat must read first. Cite paths. Structured findings.

You are a gopher. Inventory mag/ (the Python estate). Group the ~200 modules by function (orchestration, meters, games, chain, security, lanes...), name the 10 most load-bearing with one line each, and flag any module that looks abandoned or duplicated. Cite paths. Structured findings.

You are a gopher. Read dashboard/static/games/ + memory/game_modules/ + games-site/. Inventory every game, its state (playable/broken/stale), and the 5 best polish opportunities. The current prod arcade is games-mag-d961.vercel.app. Cite paths. Structured findings.

You are a gopher. Read memory/trajectory/ (steps.jsonl is huge — sample head/middle/tail) and memory/runs/. What is the shape of the fleet's actual work history: volume, eras, what kinds of tasks dominate, where the failures cluster? Cite what you sampled. Structured findings.

You are a gopher. Explore corpus/canon/ and corpus/library/ (Q archive, Mr Pool ledger, bearableguy, kev, greer, ingersoll lockwood, ractor starter). Inventory each collection: size, what it holds, what it has been used for. Cite paths. Structured findings.

You are a gopher. Inventory dashboard/static/ (263 files, 114 HTML surfaces). Group by family (games/museum/lattices/salons/walks), name the 5 most load-bearing surfaces, and flag 10 tombstone candidates (abandoned shells whose mechanism was already harvested). Cite paths. Structured findings.

You are a gopher. Read logs/failure_kb.jsonl (tail 100) + logs/ recent error logs. What are the top recurring failure classes, which are fixed vs still live, and what single fix would delete the most recurring errors? Cite evidence. Structured findings.

You are a gopher. Inspect the verkle chain state (memory/biography/verkle_tip.json, memory/biography/residual sample, tools related to the chain). Report chain tip, leaf count, health, and what the chain actually records. Cite paths. Structured findings.

You are a gopher. Read memory/runs/ghost/ (autonomous_fixes, autonomous_trail.jsonl, frustration.jsonl, director) + mag/ghost.py header. What has the autonomous layer actually done, what does it keep tripping on, and what does its frustration log say? Cite paths. Structured findings.

You are a gopher. Read memory/runs/elder_asks/ (the judicial record). List the standing Elder laws and verdicts, the freshest 3 asks, and which verdicts are still binding on daily operation. Cite paths. Structured findings.

You are a gopher. Read dashboard/static/lattices/ (law_lattice.json, law_registry.json, invariants.json, field.json) + watch/CORPUS_INDEX_FOR_BOTS_20260906.md. What is the law lattice, how many laws/invariants are registered, and is it current with the estate's actual doctrine? Cite paths. Structured findings.

You are a gopher. Read site/ (build.py, dist/work.html, dist/index.html, onboard kit). What is the beacon (a walkable 6-room game-as-a-website portfolio), what works, what is weak, and what 5 improvements would make it convert a hiring manager? Cite paths. Structured findings.
